en: Ω_in = 0.13, r₀ = 2.5 Gpc: fools the supernovae
r₀ = 300 Mpc: a candidate for the Hubble tension

zh: Ω = 0.3 处处一样：减速但不加速
en: Ω = 0.3 everywhere: decelerates but never accelerates

zh: 中心密度是远处的 §0§%　·　H₀：中心 §1§，远处 §2§ km/s/Mpc
en: Central density §0§% of the far density␣␣·␣␣H₀: center §1§, far away §2§ km/s/Mpc

zh: EdS（无空洞、无 Λ，取中心的 H₀）
en: EdS (no void, no Λ, with the central H₀)

zh: 按平坦 FLRW 拟合这条哈勃图
en: Fit this Hubble diagram with a flat FLRW model

zh: z ∈ [0.02, 1.2]，残差 rms §0§ 星等（超新星本身的散布约 0.15）§1§
en: z ∈ [0.02, 1.2], residual rms §0§ mag (the intrinsic scatter of supernovae is about 0.15)§1§

zh: ——处处一样的开放宇宙也减速得比 EdS 慢（曲率顶了一部分 Λ 的位置）：硬按平坦模型拟合就会"测"出一些 Ω_Λ，但 Ω_Λ ≈ 0.7 的加速它给不出
en: — a uniform open universe also decelerates more slowly than EdS (curvature takes over part of Λ's role): forcing a flat-model fit "measures" some Ω_Λ, but it cannot deliver the acceleration of Ω_Λ ≈ 0.7

zh: ——没有一点暗能量，却"测"出了 Ω_Λ
en: — not a drop of dark energy, yet Ω_Λ was "measured"
— the same everywhere, no void to speak of

zh: 中心 H₀ = §0§，远处 §1§ km/s/Mpc；年龄 §2§ Gyr（处处一样）
en: Central H₀ = §0§, far away §1§ km/s/Mpc; age §2§ Gyr (the same everywhere)

zh: 远处的 H₀ 对 CMB
en: The far H₀ against the CMB

zh: CMB 和 BAO 看到的是远处的宇宙：这个空洞要求远处的 H₀ 离 Planck 值太远 ✗
en: The CMB and BAO see the far universe: this void needs a far H₀ too different from the Planck value ✗

zh: 远处的 H₀ 和 CMB 的值差不多：这一关它过了
en: The far H₀ is close to the CMB value: it passes this test

zh: 空洞边缘的各向异性膨胀
en: Anisotropic expansion at the edge of the void

zh: 径向和横向膨胀率不同：BAO 的 Alcock–Paczyński 检验能量出来 ✗
en: Radial and transverse expansion rates differ: the Alcock–Paczyński test with BAO can measure it ✗

zh: 几乎各向同性：BAO 看不出
同时大爆炸是假设进去的（只留增长模）；放开它就多一个自由函数，但早期宇宙会不均匀得离谱
en: A simultaneous big bang is assumed (only the growing mode is kept); dropping it adds a free function, but the early universe would then be absurdly inhomogeneous

zh: 文献：预言比观测大约 10 倍
en: literature: predicted about 10× larger than observed

zh: 空洞里的星系团相对 CMB 有径向速度，散射出 kSZ 信号（Zhang & Stebbins 2011；Zibin & Moss 2011）✗——本页未算
en: Galaxy clusters inside the void move radially relative to the CMB and scatter a kSZ signal (Zhang & Stebbins 2011; Zibin & Moss 2011) ✗ — not computed on this page

zh: 这组参数处处一样（没有空洞），偏离"中心"没有意义：速度 = 0，偶极 = 0。
en: These parameters are the same everywhere (no void), so "off-center" means nothing: velocity = 0, dipole = 0.

zh: 偏离中心 §0§ Mpc：相对远处 CMB 的速度 ≈ (H(d) − H_out)·d = §1§ km/s，偶极 ΔT/T ≈ §2§（观测到的整个偶极 1.23×10⁻³，通常全归给太阳系的运动）。§3§
en: §0§ Mpc off center: velocity relative to the distant CMB ≈ (H(d) − H_out)·d = §1§ km/s, dipole ΔT/T ≈ §2§ (the whole observed dipole is 1.23×10⁻³, usually attributed entirely to the motion of the solar system). §3§

zh: 这么大的额外偶极藏不住：你必须离中心更近。
en: An extra dipole this large cannot be hidden: you must be closer to the center.

zh: 藏在太阳系运动的偶极里还不会露馅——但这要求我们离这个半径 §0§ 的空洞的中心不到 §1§ Mpc：按体积算是 (d/r₀)³ ≈ §2§ 的巧合（哥白尼原理）。
en: It could still hide inside the dipole from the solar system's motion — but that requires us to be within §1§ Mpc of the center of this void of radius §0§: by volume a coincidence of (d/r₀)³ ≈ §2§ (the Copernican principle).

zh: 由同时大爆炸定出：Ω 越小的壳层，同样的年龄要求越大的 H
en: fixed by the simultaneous big bang: the smaller a shell's Ω, the larger the H the same age requires

zh: 超新星样本里最远的 z ≈ 1–2：空洞必须大到这个尺度才骗得过
en: the farthest supernovae in the sample are at z ≈ 1–2: the void must be this large to fool them
